findings.claim: No test exercises the acceptance criterion that MessagePack attributes on the formatted type are honoured. Every external data type is explicitly attribute-free, so the unconditional contractless collection path can ignore such attributes without any test failing.

With the current unconditional CreateContractlessMembers call this should expose the missing behaviour.

findings.claim: Surrogate tests use only integer keys. Consequently a formatter collector that always selects integer-key mode for surrogates would pass the entire added suite, leaving string-key surrogate output unverified.

receipt_plan.detail: src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/CodeAnalysis/GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs:76 remove-guard: if (isClass && !type.InstanceConstructors.Any(...)) { ... return null; } -> statement removed; expected to survive because no test formats a class having only parameterized or inaccessible constructors.

findings.claim: The contractless field writability check is not covered because ExternalPerson, ExternalPoint, and ExternalWidget contain only properties. A public read-only field could incorrectly enter the serialization model without a test failing.
